summary: Fresh complete independent canonical audit: all 231 Chinese units, 451 temporal or active-hint items, and 111 people were checked. Most regnal dates, era ranges, precision, event ownership, and later-reception classifications are source-grounded. Sixteen linked claim/hint items across eight people require revision because chapter headings, a posthumous grant, undated social context, relatives’ records, and bare offices were converted into unsupported personal activity intervals. The chapter therefore remains needs-revision; no extraction change was made by this audit.
